capabilities: Sweep checked items to the bottom of their checkbox group
Move TODO branches up or down together with all their sub-items
Keep completed tasks sorted below open tasks in Reading View
Animate the move with a ghost of the checked row
Undo the check and the move in a single step
disambiguation: Only reorders checklist items; it does not track task metadata such as dates, priorities, or recurring tasks.
extras: Renamed from "Auto Sort Checked Items"; the plugin ID is unchanged so existing installations update normally.
intentEvidence: Obsidian's built-in Move line up and Move line down commands only move one line.
problem: Obsidian leaves checked items in place, and its built-in move-line commands shift only a single line instead of a whole nested branch.
summary: Checklist plugin that automatically moves checked items to the bottom of a list while keeping nested sub-items together as a group.
